summary_en: CE Holdings will cancel all treasury shares held as of the cancellation date of January 14, 2027, contingent on shareholder approval of a stock split effective January 15, 2027 and completion of a self-tender offer announced in August 2026. The number of shares to be cancelled will be determined on the cancellation date.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, CE Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares held by the company as of January 14, 2027, in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is contingent upon two conditions: (1) shareholder approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for November 13, 2026, of a stock split with an effective date of January 15, 2027, and (2) successful completion of a self-tender offer for treasury shares announced in August 2026 (with amendments as of August 31, 2026).

As of September 30, 2026, the company held 363,863 treasury shares out of 17,039,400 total shares issued including treasury shares. The specific number of shares to be cancelled will be determined based on the company's treasury share holdings on the cancellation date of January 14, 2027. The disclosure does not provide the number of shares expected to be cancelled, the percentage of outstanding shares this will represent, or any other financial metrics associated with the cancellation, as these depend on the outcome of the pending self-tender offer.
